# Fibonacci sequence

# define the first two values
fib = [1, 1]

# iterate for 10 steps
for i in range(10):
    # calculate next value as sum of previous two values of the list
    nextval = fib[-1]+fib[-2]
    # join it to the end of the list
    fib.append(nextval) 

# Print the list
print(fib)
